messages:
marie: Heads up — IDS flagged vault-proxy (proxy-99) issuing a read to secret path `secret/data/partner/integrations` from unusual IP 198.51.100.23. Token lease looks long. Possible leaked credential in partner webhook payload. Need emergency rotate + RBAC lockdown. @jamal @sasha :eyes:

sec-bot: Alert summary: vault-proxy anomalous access detected. proxy=proxy-99, src_ip=198.51.100.23, path=secret/data/partner/integrations, lease_ttl=768h. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vault-anomalies> :rotating_light:

jamal: Oncall here — confirmed the log entries. I'll revoke the lease and start a transit rewrap. Will coordinate with eng-platform for k8s SA rotation. ETA ~30m. :thumbsup:

sasha: Please snapshot audit logs before any writes. We want a cold copy for forensic. E.g.:
```bash
sudo cp /var/log/vault-audit.log /tmp/vault-audit-snapshot-$(date +%s).log
```
Do that first, @luis-oncall?

luis-oncall: Copying audit log now to /tmp and S3 archive (s3://sec-forensics/1740539999/). Starting now.

jamal: Steps I'm going to run (summarized):
1) revoke affected leases/tokens
2) rewrap secrets via transit (force new ciphertext)
3) revoke any long-lived k8s tokens and patch RBAC
Commands I will run: 
```bash
# revoke leases under the prefix
vault lease revoke -prefix secret/data/partner/integrations || vault token revoke -self
# rewrap via transit (example)
vault write -f transit/rewrap/partner-integration
```
Posting progress here when started.

eng-platform: We can patch the cluster RoleBinding to remove the partner SA and issue a short-lived projected token. Example patch: 
```bash
kubectl -n integrations patch rolebinding partner-integration-binding --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/subjects/1"}]'
# create short-lived serviceaccount token for migration consumers
kubectl create token temp-rotator -n integrations --duration=10m
```
We also recommend adding an admission policy to block long-lived tokens for that namespace.

partners-liaison: Notified the partner on the secure channel and asked them to rotate inbound webhook secret immediately. They acknowledged and are standing by for a coordinated switchover. Window requested: 45m.

marie: Good. Also add a quick audit flag for any KV read on `secret/data/partner/*` in the last 24h — want to see potential exfil destinations. Run a grep over the forwarded audits.

luis-oncall: Audit snapshot done and uploaded. grep summary: 3 distinct external IPs pulled that path in the last 24h, including 198.51.100.23. I've attached the file to the incident ticket.

jamal: Starting revoke now. Command: `vault lease revoke -prefix secret/data/partner/integrations` -> returned OK (revoked 1 leases). Starting rewrap: `vault write -f transit/rewrap/partner-integration` -> job queued.

sasha: RBAC patch prepared; will remove the rolebinding and replace with scoped binding without token automount. Patch snippet: 
```bash
kubectl -n integrations apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: partner-integration-binding
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: partner-rotator
  namespace: integrations
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: integration-reader
EOF
# also annotate SA to disable automount
kubectl -n integrations patch sa partner-rotator -p '{"automountServiceAccountToken": false}'
```
I'll apply once jamal confirms rewrap success.

eng-platform: Also removing Cloud KMS IAM binding for proxy SA to prevent onsite wrap/unwarp while we investigate: 
```bash
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/rewrap-key --member="serviceAccount:proxy-99@myproj.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```
We will log the change for audit.

partners-liaison: Partner confirmed they will generate a new webhook secret and rotate on their side within the window. They asked for the old credentials to be revoked immediately (they received the audit summary).

marie: After rewrap and RBAC patch, we should run detection queries for data egress (S3 uploads, external webhook deliveries) and rotate any derived credentials (CI tokens, cached API keys). Keep this thread for timeline updates. :lock:

jamal: Rewrap completed OK. RBAC patch applied by @sasha. Cloud KMS IAM binding removed by @eng-platform. I also revoked any known long-lived tokens I could find. Will run a final audit check and report back in ~15m.

luis-oncall: Final audit grep run: no further reads after revoke timestamp. Uploading final artifacts to ticket.

marie: Thanks team — filing follow-up action items: 1) full credential sweep for partners namespace, 2) audit policy to alert on long-lived leases, 3) update runbook to include immediate KMS IAM revocation step. I'll create the tickets and assign. Closing this triage thread, keep incident ticket open until partner confirms production rotate. :white_check_mark:
